facts.text: `MCPManager.discover` registers each discovered MCP tool as `mcp__${id}__${t.name}`, and the `mcp-fallback` extension adds registered tools whose names start with `mcp__` to the active tools.

TaskManage discovers linked worktree roots by running `git -C <workspaceRoot> worktree list --porcelain` via `execFileSync` with a 5000 ms timeout. Failures yield an empty list. The result is cached only for the current execute batch (`this.worktrees` is reset in `execute`), not for 60 seconds.

`evaluateToolCall` in the structure guard blocks creation targets when the loaded project structure policy has `enforcement === "block"`. Targets come from `*** Add File:` lines in apply_patch, and from write/edit/notebookedit/multiedit path arguments and conservative Bash creation targets.

The TaskManage builtin hook in block mode blocks any tool call that is not exempt and has no focused task. Exemptions include TaskManage and read-only tools. Read-only Bash is exempt, so apply_patch and mutating Bash are blocked until a task is focused.

`resolveWorkdir` in `swarm-bash.ts` only checks that the Bash cwd exists and is a directory. It no longer applies `checkAllowedPath`, and CHANGELOG states that Bash `cwd` and `apply_patch` no longer reject paths outside the workspace.
The `swarm-apply-patch` test `lets apply_patch write outside the workspace` asserts that a patch to a file outside the workspace succeeds. It no longer asserts rejection.

Pi RPC uses JSONL over stdin/stdout with an `id` field for request correlation. Tern TSP is not JSONL and travels over the pane pty as APC or OSC 877, so a Tern UI integration would need to bridge two transports. This is a research map, not an implemented integration.

The vendored pi-mono is v0.78.1 (`vendor/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/package.json`), while the installed Pi dist is v1.1.0. The integration map notes the two differ and lists reconciling them as an open step, so vendored-source API conclusions may not match the installed runtime.

Pi RPC has no permission model. Interactive decisions go through `extension_ui_request`/`extension_ui_response`. `confirm` defaults to false on abort, timeout, or cancel, and headless callers must handle `hasUI === false`. This is source-attributed in the integration map, not runtime-verified.

The Tern SDK reference capture under `docs/reference/tern-sdk/` is pinned to `stencil-hq/tern-sdk` commit `38a4c06224a32ae81d1c7af67b1b386422f3fc7b`. `SOURCE-MANIFEST.md` records source links, SHA-256 hashes, and exclusions.
